title: CandidateChange
description: A proposed change to an artifact, with operations, rationale, and validation plan.

change_id.description: Unique identifier for this change proposal.

operations.description: List of text operations to apply. Each is an object with an 'operation' key ('append' or 'replace') and a 'text' key.

rationale.description: Explanation of why this change is proposed.

validation_plan.description: Steps to validate that the change is safe.

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata including signal_id, strategy_id, before_scores, after_scores.
